<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈178.0873 Da. The molecular formula that matches this mass within ~3 ppm is C₁₀H₁₂NO₂ (exact mass 178.0868 Da). Therefore the chemical formula of the sample compound is C10H12NO2.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H12NO2</final_answer>
